Floor 5 has a tenant, the Houston Symphony, and the call says 'a lot of us' are there. Don't invent a headcount. Say occupancy is unknown and that the caller reports many people on 5.

Say what the call said: electrical-burning smell, smoke thickening near the copy room, no flames, and the alarm not sounding. Your message never mentions the smoke type or the silent alarm, and it leaves out that the caller is asking whether to evacuate.
